He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia Cavaliers]]. ==Early life and high school career== Dunn grew up in [[Baldwin, Nassau County, New York]]. He initially attended [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] in [[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]] as a boarding student, where he played on the school's third basketball team.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbs19news.com/story/48279553/from-out-of-nowhere-ryan-dunn-energizes-virginia|title=From out of nowhere Ryan Dunn energizes Virginia|website=[[WCAV|CBS19New.com]]|date=January 31, 2023|access-date=October 17, 2023}} After his sophomore year he transferred to [[Long Island Lutheran Middle and High School|Long Island Lutheran High School]].{{cite web |last=Fuller |first=Marcus |date=September 10, 2021 |title=Four-star NY guard Ryan Dunn on recent Gophers official visit: "fan base in Minnesota was really big" |url=https://www.startribune.com/four-star-ny-guard-ryan-dunn-on-recent-gophers-official-visit-fan-base-in-minnesota-was-really-big/600095922/ |access-date=October 18, 2023 |work=[[Star Tribune]]}} Dunn averaged 9 points and 4 assists per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/high-school/boys-basketball/top-100-players-long-island-2021-w69660|title=Top 100 boys basketball players on Long Island for 2021|work=[[Newsday]]|date=February 9, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}} After graduating from Long Island Lutheran, he opted to enroll at the [[Perkiomen School]] in [[Pennsburg, Pennsylvania]] for a [[postgraduate year]].{{cite web|url=https://dailyprogress.com/sports/unique-high-school-basketball-journey-helped-prepare-ryan-dunn-to-thrive-at-virginia/article_aca6221e-bddd-11ed-a22a-7f458d9afc78.html|title=Unique high school basketball journey helped prepare Ryan Dunn to thrive at Virginia|first=Greg|last=Madia|work=[[The Daily Progress]]|date=March 8, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2023}} In his lone prep year, he averaged 11.9 points and 7.1 rebounds. At the same time, Dunn tallied 38 steals and 30 blocks in 27 games. He led Perkiomen to their first-ever state title appearance alongside [[Xaivian Lee]] and [[Thomas Haugh]]. They qualified for the National Prep Tournament in the same year. Dunn was rated a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to play at [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] over offers from [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]], [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]], [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]], [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]], and [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/virginia/basketball/uva-mens-basketball-receives-commitment-from-ryan-dunn|title=Four-Star Recruit Ryan Dunn Commits to Virginia|first=Matt|last=Newton|website=[[SI.com]]|date=September 18, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.startribune.com/new-york-four-star-2022-guard-ryan-dunn-picks-virginia-over-the-gophers/600098512/|title=New York four-star 2022 guard Ryan Dunn picks Virginia over the Gophers|work=[[Star Tribune]]|date=September 18, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2023}} ==College career== Dunn was a key bench player during his freshman year at Virginia.{{cite web|url=https://dailyprogress.com/sports/virginias-overhauled-very-athletic-roster-makes-for-critical-summer/article_87bb7b98-270f-11ee-b571-a3761968aaa3.html|title=Virginia's overhauled, 'very athletic' roster makes for critical summer|work=[[The Daily Progress]]|date=July 21, 2023|access-date=October 24, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nbc29.com/2023/03/09/first-year-ryan-dunn-providing-spark-off-bench-virginia/|title=First-year Ryan Dunn providing spark off the bench for Virginia|first=Marty|last=Hudtloff|website=[[WVIR-TV|NBC29.com]]|date=March 9, 2023|access-date=October 24, 2023}} He averaged 2.6 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 1.1 blocks in 31 games played during his freshman season.{{cite web|url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/despite-naysayers-virginia-basketball-could-be-back-even-stronger-next-season/article_f50e1ed8-c5d7-11ed-a9f1-ff80fd7b92c5.html|title=Despite naysayers, Virginia basketball could be back even stronger next season|first=Mike|last=Barber|work=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]]|date=March 19, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.streakingthelawn.com/2023/10/18/23919452/virginia-cavaliers-uva-basketball-ryan-dunn-nba-draft-board-virginia-basketball|title=How can Virginia basketball’s Ryan Dunn become a star?|first=John J.|last=Kurcina|website=StreakingTheLawn.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=October 18, 2023|access-date=October 24, 2023}} Dunn averaged 8.1 points, 6.9 rebounds, 2.3 blocks and 1.3 steals per game as a sophomore. Following the season he declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]],{{cite news |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=Potential 1st-round pick, UVA's Ryan Dunn, to enter NBA draft |url=https://africa.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39954085/potential-1st-round-pick-uva-ryan-dunn-enter-nba-draft |access-date=July 1, 2024 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=April 16, 2024}} where he was widely considered the best defensive player available. ==Professional career== On June 26, 2024, Dunn was selected with the 28th overall pick by the [[Denver Nuggets]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]], however, immediately on draft night, he was traded to the Phoenix Suns alongside the 56th overall pick in the 2024 draft and second-round picks in 2026 and 2031 in exchange for the 22nd overall pick in the 2024 draft.{{cite web|title=Suns Acquire Forward Ryan Dunn in 2024 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/suns/news/suns-acquire-forward-ryan-dunn-in-2024-nba-draft|website=NBA.com|access-date=June 27, 2024}} On July 2, he signed a contract with Phoenix.{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Ryan Dunn Signs Rookie Scale Contract With Suns|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/07/ryan-dunn-signs-rookie-scale-contract-with-suns.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=July 2, 2024|access-date=July 2, 2024}} Dunn made his NBA debut on October 23, recording two points, two rebounds, a steal, and a block in nearly nine minutes of play in the Suns' 116–113 overtime win over the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] held in their new home arena, [[Intuit Dome]]. In only his third game played just three days later, Dunn made his first start for the Suns due to a [[Bradley Beal]] injury on his right elbow. For that night's game, he scored a then-season-high 13 points as a starter in a 114–102 win over the defending Western Conference champion [[Dallas Mavericks]] in the Suns' home opener game. On [[Halloween|October 31]], Dunn scored a then-season-high 16 points in his second start in a 125–119 win over the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].https://www.nba.com/game/0022400131 With the Suns sitting at 15–18 to begin the 2025 part of their 2024–25 campaign, the Suns elected to move Dunn into their starting lineup in place of [[Bradley Beal]], beginning in their January 6, 2025 game against the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].{{cite news |last=Zimmerman |first=Kevin |title=Suns to bench Bradley Beal, Jusuf Nurkic as tensions rise |url=https://arizonasports.com/story/3569487/suns-bench-bradley-beal-nurkic/ |access-date=January 7, 2025 |work=arizonasports.com |date=January 6, 2025}} On January 16, Dunn recorded his first double-double of his professional career with season-highs of 18 points (from 8/12 shooting, including 2/3 three-pointers made) and 11 rebounds as a starter in Phoenix's 130–123 win over the [[Washington Wizards]], bringing the team back to a .500 record.https://www.nba.com/game/0022400573 On April 11, Dunn scored a career-high 26 points and tied a career-high with 11 rebounds in a 117–98 victory over the [[2024–25 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio Spurs]].{{Cite web|title=Suns Notes: Beal, Dunn, Bol, Booker|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/04/suns-notes-beal-dunn-bol-booker.html|access-date=July 18, 2025|website=hoopsrumors.com|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics
